Recompute \(11002 \bmod 7\):
\[
11002 - 7\cdot 1571 = 11002 - 10997 = 5.
\]
So
\[
x \equiv -5 \equiv 2 \pmod 7.
\]
Combined with \(x \equiv 9 \pmod{11}\):
\[
x = 9 + 11k.
\]
Modulo \(7\):
\[
9 + 11k \equiv 2 + 4k \equiv 2 \pmod 7
\]
\[
4k \equiv 0 \pmod 7 \implies k \equiv 0 \pmod 7.
\]
Thus
\[
x = 9 + 77t.
\]
The smallest positive values are \(9,86,163,\dots\). Since \(9\) and \(86\) are not prime, and \(163\) is prime:
\[
\boxed{163}
\]
